item.title: After failed execution, health workers say Tennessee's method flouts medical ethics
item.description: After a botched lethal injection in May, dozens of Tennessee medical professionals told the governor that healthcare professionals shouldn't help with executions, no matter the method.

item.title: Travel plans? Here's what to know as measles exposures reach trains and games
item.description: Measles is traveling, with outbreaks in Pennsylvania, Ohio and New York, and exposures on transportation and in sports. What should you know before getting on a plane or train?

item.title: What's behind HHS claims that gender-affirming care 'may' radicalize
item.description: The report is the agency's latest effort to chip away at trust in established health care models for transgender people. Critics say it frames transgender identity as illegitimate or even dangerous.

item.title: Montana starts enforcing Medicaid work requirements on Oct 1. Patients are confused
item.description: In most states, people with Medicaid coverage will have to prove they're working, volunteering or studying, starting Jan. 1. But Montana is starting that early, and it's sowing confusion and anxiety.

item.title: They were promised protection. Instead, these kids with disabilities died in foster care
item.description: Disabled kids make up the largest group in foster care. They have the worst outcomes. They stay in foster care longest. They're the most likely to die.

item.title: Drugs are widely used to sedate dementia patients. Her sons wanted to keep her off them
item.description: Potent sedating medications are often used on agitated people with dementia in long-term care facilities despite federal efforts to discourage them. A clash over whether to drug a Michigan woman illuminates the wrenching decisions families and guardians face.

item.title: Rural voters support MAHA movement, but feel little impact, poll finds
item.description: A new poll from KFF-AP shows that rural voters support the Make America Healthy Again movement, but they don't think it's had a positive impact on their lives.
